title: Ali Ko Cheenk Aayi! 🤧 | Cheenk Aane Par Kya Kehte Hain? | Islamic Cartoon for Kids
description:
Ali ko phool soonghte hue cheenk aa gayi! 🤧 Dadu ne pyaar se sikhaya ki cheenk aane par kya kehte hain aur uska jawab kya hai. 🤲

📖 Hadith:
Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ki Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya:
"Jab tum mein se kisi ko cheenk aaye to woh kahe 'Alhamdulillah', aur uska bhai ya saathi kahe 'Yarhamukallah' (Allah tum par reham kare). Jab woh 'Yarhamukallah' kahe, to cheenkne wala kahe 'Yahdikumullahu wa yuslihu baalakum' (Allah tumhein hidayat de aur tumhara haal behtar kare)."
— Sahih Bukhari 6224 (Sahih)

✅ Cheenk aaye: Alhamdulillah
✅ Sunne wala kahe: Yarhamukallah
✅ Jawab: Yahdikumullahu wa yuslihu baalakum
